feeds.title: Smart Church Management
feeds.description: We love churches and have created resources to help you manage the day-to-day operation of your ministry. SCM has had the privilege of sharing helpful content with church leaders, volunteers, and employees.

feeds.title: Ridgecrest Conference Center Blog
feeds.description: Ridgecrest Conference Center Blog is designed specifically to provide meeting planners and event coordinators with tips and ideas to execute the perfect event. Ridgecrest is the premier place to host your Christian meeting, event, or spiritual retreat. Located less than a day's drive from over 15 states, our convenient location, beautiful setting, and purposeful hospitality make it a favorite among event planners, conference or meeting attendees, ministers, couples, youth, and families.

feeds.title: Religious Conference Management Association
feeds.description: Founded in 1972, RCMA is the proven faith-based association for meeting planners and suppliers, nurturing a community that inspires exceptional meetings. We are responsible for planning and/or managing meetings, tutorials, conferences, conventions, and assemblies for their religious organizations. We create an atmosphere where both planners and suppliers join together to learn from each other's experiences.

feeds.title: Christian Camp Pro
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Andy McClung! I've hosted hundreds of retreats over the last 15 years. I'm here to help you plan the best retreat ever by providing helpful games, themes, tips, and ideas perfectly suited for your event.
